title: `PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING` returns the path to the script for a custom node but the name of the node for a default node
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in : 4.6.stable
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.6881) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1235U (12 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory

### Issue description

In version 4.5, when using the `PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING` the string becomes populated with the name of the class after selecting it in the dialog. This is useful since you can use the name of the class with `ClassDB` to instantiate an class object in code. And in .NET you can check all the types in the assembly to match the name of the type using reflection if `ClassDB` couldn't find it.

In version 4.6, when using the `PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING` the string becomes populated with the name of the class ONLY if it's a default class. But the string gets populated with the resource path if it's a custom class. For example:

- Selecting: `Camera3D` will populate the string with `Camera3D`. (This is a default class and `ClassDB` can instantiate from this).
- Selecting: `CustomNode3D` will populate the string with `res://custom_node_3d.gd`. (This is a custom class and `ClassDB` can no longer instantiate from this).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create an exported variable with the `PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING`:
```gdscript
@export_custom(PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING, "Node") var value: String
```
2. If not created already, make at least one (1) custom class with the `class_name` keyword so it can be found in the dialog box:
```gdscript
class_name TestNode
extends Node
```
3. Instantiate the Node or Resource with the exported variable and in the Inspector click on the variable and change it's value to `Node3D` using the dialog box and observe it's value in the Inspector.
4. Change it's value to `TestNode` using the dialog box and observe it's value in the Inspector.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The bug is not project dependent, but I will still provide a MRP

[TestTypeString.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25052747/TestTypeString.zip)
